description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Personal information and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InventoryUpdate" name="Seat inventory update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TravelInstructions" name="Check-in or boarding reminders and instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking" name="Ticket booking">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails" name="Booking details" sourceRef="Task_SendBookingDetails" targetRef="StartEvent_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InventoryUpdate" name="Seat inventory update" sourceRef="Task_SendInventoryUpdate" targetRef="StartEvent_InventoryUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TravelInstructions" name="Travel reminders and instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendTravelInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTravelInstructions"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket booking and journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerSearch" name="Customer searches for a ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select preferred route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendBookingDetails" name="Send booking details" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerReminderChoice" name="Receive pre-travel reminders?" default="Flow_CustomerNoReminder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTravelInstructions" name="Receive check-in or boarding reminders and instructions" messageRef="Message_TravelInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder choice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravelChoice" name="Post-travel feedback or services?" default="Flow_NoPostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide feedback or use post-travel services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyComplete" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete" name="Post-travel activity completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerSearch" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_SendBookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SendBookingDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerReminderChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerReceiveReminder" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerReminderChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTravelInstructions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><![CDATA[reminders are received]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerNoReminder" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerReminderChoice" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerReminderReceived" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTravelInstructions" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerReminderMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelChoice" targetRef="Task_PostTravel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><![CDATA[post-travel feedback or services are used]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPostTravel" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelChoice" targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravelComplete" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BookingSystem" name="Booking system workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingDetails" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingDetails" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BookingSplit" name="Send ticket and update inventory"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket by email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInventoryUpdate" name="Send seat inventory update" messageRef="Message_InventoryUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BookingJoin" name="Ticket sent and inventory update sent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderChoice" name="Send pre-travel reminders?" default="Flow_NoReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTravelInstructions" name="Send check-in or boarding reminders and instructions before travel" messageRef="Message_TravelInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder choice"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BookingSystem" name="Booking workflow completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_BookingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_3" sourceRef="Gateway_BookingSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_4" sourceRef="Gateway_BookingSplit" targetRef="Task_SendInventoryUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_5" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_BookingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_6" sourceRef="Task_SendInventoryUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_BookingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_7" sourceRef="Gateway_BookingJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendReminder" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Task_SendTravelInstructions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><![CDATA[pre-travel reminders are sent]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReminder" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderSent" sourceRef="Task_SendTravelInstructions" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_BookingSystem"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company seat inventory workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InventoryUpdate" name="Seat inventory update received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_InventoryUpdate" messageRef="Message_InventoryUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated" name="Seat inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_InventoryUpdate" targetRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" targetRef="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
